import os,json
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    def comps(g):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(len(g)):
            for j in range(len(g[0])):
                if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                    q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                    while q:
                        y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):
                            for dx in(-1,0,1):
                                a,b=y+dy,x+dx
                                if 0<=a<len(g) and 0<=b<len(g[0]) and g[a][b] and (a,b) not in seen:
                                    seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                    out.append(cells)
        return out
    def bounding(cells,g):
        ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        return [[g[i][j] for j in range(x0,x1+1)] for i in range(y0,y1+1)]
    shapes=[bounding(c,grid) for c in comps(grid)]
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(len(s),len(s[0])))
    a,b=shapes[0],shapes[1]
    h=min(len(a),len(b)); w=min(len(a[0]),len(b[0]))
    rows=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
    cols=[j for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    return [[8 if a[i][j]!=b[i][j] else 0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
'''
open('programs/task-02673c75.py','w').write(code)
